title: Clock-In Hazard Scan
briefing: Before you tie your apron, eyeball the kitchen. Tap every hazard you see. Miss one and OSHA can shut us down.

expertRecipe.name: Kitchen Safety Walkthrough
expertRecipe.platingStandard: All hazards identified, corrective actions noted, zero missed critical hazards.

steps.instruction: Scan floors for wet spots, debris, and tripping hazards.
steps.whyExplanation: Slips and falls are the #1 kitchen injury. A wet floor near the fryer is a burn risk.
Blocked exits violate fire code. In a grease fire, seconds matter.

steps.instruction: Verify fire extinguisher is charged and accessible.
steps.whyExplanation: An expired or buried extinguisher is the same as no extinguisher.

steps.instruction: Check knife storage: blades sheathed or in magnetic strip.
steps.whyExplanation: Loose knives in a drawer cause lacerations. Proper storage is non-negotiable.

criticalControlPoints.consequence: OSHA fine up to $15,625 per violation. Fire marshal can close the kitchen immediately.
